extracted.intended_audience: readers of Nature (scientists, naturalists, museum curators, educators and scientifically literate public)
extracted.subtask_description: A journal page combining classified academic/science job advertisements and critical book reviews/letters. Contains candidate qualifications and procedural ad instructions plus evaluative criteria for scientific books and textbooks (clarity, illustrations, scientific grounding, pedagogical method).

rubrics_metrics.name: Engineering lecturer/demonstrator qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates must have gone through a complete University course in engineering and have also had some practical experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications should be accompanied by testimonials and sent to the Registrar by the stated deadline (applications, accompanied by testimonials, should be sent on or before July 1). Further particulars obtainable from the undersigned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lecturer in Electrical Technology appointment procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Council invite applications for the post of LECTURER in ELECTRICAL TECHNOLOGY.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Further particulars may be obtained from the undersigned (Registrar). Applications expected to follow standard institutional submission procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrator in Chemistry application requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications will be received up to the stated date for appointment to a DEMONSTRATORSHIP; salary specified (given on page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Further particulars may be obtained from the Registrar; applicants should note closing date and salary as part of their application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assistant Mistress (school) required qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Wanted: ASSISTANT MISTRESS. Degree or equivalent; High Classics and English; German. Disciplinarian. Experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comencing salary listed; applicants must apply by stated deadline to Headmaster and should meet the subject and disciplinary criteria specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agricultural Chemist / laboratory head requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Agricultural Chemist wanted to take charge of Chemistry Dept.; specified salary and other posts/starting salaries provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be prepared to assume departmental charge; contact details and hours provided for enquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manager of Smelting Works qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Manager wanted to take charge of large smelting works employing about 600 men. Must have up-to-date knowledge of smelting — Copper, Lead, Silver and Gold Ores.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should apply giving age, particulars of experience and salary required (address given: '1964, c/o Nature').

rubrics_metrics.name: Partner/Investor specification for laboratory development
rubrics_metrics.description: Partner with £500 required to develop established Micro Laboratory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ad emphasizes opportunity and prospective returns; prospective partners instructed how to reply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrator for Chemical Laboratory — experience disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrator for a Chemical Laboratory wanted for September next — apply, giving particulars of experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants to supply details of practical experience; contact name and institution provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertisement procedural requirement (announcements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Announcements of Births, Marriages and Deaths are inserted in the advertisement pages of 'Nature' at 3s. 0d. for two lines of eighteen words. Each additional line of nine words costs etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All orders should be accompanied by remittance to cover cost; office address given (Office of 'Nature', St. Martin's Street).

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity and authoritative exposition (book review criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: The work should present a clear exposition of anatomical structure, mode of production, and mechanisms (e.g., 'Nowhere have we met with a clearer exposition of the anatomical structure of the larynx, the mode of voice production, and the mechanism of breathing').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Diagrams that clearly show the action of muscles are highly commended; clarity of exposition is a primary evaluative measure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use and quality of illustrative material (books/textbooks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrations and diagrammatic figures showing action (e.g., of muscles) are specially to be commended; photographic plates are often preferable to woodcuts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewer criticizes absence of photographic process-work and suggests typical photographs of collections would be valuable. For student texts, 'illustrated' is repeatedly noted as a positive attribute; plates/photos should accurately represent specimens or mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific grounding and correct theoretical framing
rubrics_metrics.description: A book should place the subject on a scientific basis, adopt the currently accepted explanatory frameworks, and correct outdated views where warranted ('The book places voice production on a scientific basis.'; 'The author rightly discredits the old-fashioned view...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims should be tied to scientific explanation (e.g., pressure variations in the larynx) and not rest on unsupported statements; adopt theories taught and accepted by the field when justified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoiding over-interpretation (coincidence vs causation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Criticism when an author tends to make coincidence into causal connection (the italics point out 'his tendency at times to make coincidence into causal connection').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors/reviewers should beware of inferring causal relationships from mere coincidences or superficial parallels; assert causation only when supported by evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pedagogical principle for school chemistry texts
rubrics_metrics.description: Method of teaching chemistry based on the principle of working from the known to the unknown; books written as suggestions to the teacher with clear, concise directions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Textbooks should include graduated exercises, hints on methods, questions, and excellent illustrations; the form of the book (suggestions to the teacher) and practical applicability are important evaluative factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Textbook features valued for students
rubrics_metrics.description: Student physics/chemistry books should provide exercises in practical physics, questions, graduated material arranged in order of difficulty, and practical hints (e.g., 'Exercises in Practical Physics', 'With Questions', 'Graduated and arranged in order of difficulty').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inclusion of questions, exercises, and stages/parts (mechanics, heat, magnetism, etc.) and clear arrangements for progressive learning are important; pricing/format notes (globe 8vo, crown 8vo) indicate intended audience and level.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical, clinical evidence and selection criteria (applied studies)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of clinical examination data and selection results as evidence of practical applicability (example: of 44 voices examined for professional singing, 8 were chosen and 36 rejected as unsuitable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Including actual selection outcomes and clinical observations strengthens a book's practical credibility and provides concrete criteria for suitability in applied professions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensiveness and audience suitability
rubrics_metrics.description: Books are evaluated on their breadth and fit for intended readers — e.g., 'Psychologists and students of invention will find this a masterly book', 'Many teachers have taught empirically, but the scientific knowledge is the surest guide.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers value works that direct attention to fruitful series of facts and that serve specific scholarly or teaching communities; suitability for target audience and contribution to the field are criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of indexing and ease-of-reference
rubrics_metrics.description: Absence of an index is a noted deficiency ('There is no index.'), implying that books should include an index for usability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers recommend inclusion of an index for reference works and monographs to increase practical usability for researchers, students, and curators.
